text:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — planning a 'spotlight' gradual rollout of inference-service v2.0 starting 22:00 UTC today. Looking for a deploy lead + smoke owner. rough plan: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~45m with health gates. pinging @Lina for smoke ops and @Priya for cohort selection.
Jason Park: I can take deploy lead if someone else owns smoke. available at 21:45 UTC to do the handoff.
DeployBot: Deployment job created: job_id=deploy-5043211234, target=infra-prod, image=inference-service:v2.0-rc. Tags: spotlight-rollout. (Use /cancel-deploy <job_id> to abort)
Priya Rao: Quick Q on cohorts — prefer geo-slices or user-ids? For this model I'd bias toward low-traffic geo buckets + internal traffic first. avoids surprise spikes.
Lina Ortiz: I'll own smoke. smoke checklist: 1) smoke mode inference end-to-end (happy-path) 2) latency P50/P95 check vs baseline 3) error-rate < 0.5% 4) memory/gpu util sanity 5) tracing tags present. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/spotlight/v2 (monitor panel: inference_spotlight_overview)
Rick Malone: Suggest ramp steps and durations: 1% for 10m, 5% for 15m, 20% for 20m. Abort thresholds: latency P95 > baseline +200ms OR error-rate delta > 0.3%. rollout config snippet:
```
rollout:
  - percent: 1
    duration: 10m
    pause: true
  - percent: 5
    duration: 15m
    pause: true
  - percent: 20
    duration: 20m
    pause: false
```
Keep small warmup prefix caching for first two slices.
Maya Chen: SGTM. @Jason please run the deploy window at 22:00 UTC. @Lina will call green on smoke at each pause. I'll trigger the config pin when we hit 20% if metrics look good.
Jason Park: I'll kick it off. My preflight: infra smoke green, canary image checksum verified, rollforward path tested. I'll post `/deploy run deploy-5043211234 --rollout-config spotlight-v2` here when starting.
Priya Rao: Also recommend soft cohort: internal-beta + 0.5% of steady traffic (header=internal-test) to exercise long-tail prompts before public wedge.
Lina Ortiz: Noted. Oncall: @Rick will be primary pager for the first 30m after each step, I'll be backup. If anything goes wrong do immediate rollback: `/deploy cancel deploy-5043211234` + tag ops channel. Runbook excerpt (short): "If P95 spike or error surge, stop rollout, mark release as paused, roll back to v1.8, notify product and cs." Full runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/spotlight-rollouts
DeployBot: job_id=deploy-5043211234 started by Jason Park at 22:00 UTC. Current state: step 1 (1%). logs: https://ci.redwood/deploys/deploy-5043211234/logs
Jason Park: Starting now. I'll post quick updates at each pause. :rocket:
Maya Chen: Thanks team — will monitor the metrics and be ready to pin/roll back. ping here if anything odd. :thumbsup:
